name: Morikubo Yuna
source: A wealthy and well bred young woman from a prestigious family. She has the family duty to always be top class. Her grandfather owns Berry's along with many other companies and holdings and therefore suggested to Yuna to gain work experience by working at the restaurant. Despite her status and upbringing she is hired as a simple waitress and treated the same as all the other employees. She is uncertain about relationships and love and sometimes acts shy around boys.
